description:
AUDITED at origin/main a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83 (2026-09-02).

## Status

LIVE, but the previous diagnosis was too downstream.

This ticket now owns only the remaining third finding from its original three-item bundle. The list-of-closures and closure-in-map findings remain out of scope following their earlier successful retest.

## Goal

A function may select one of its callable arguments and return it. Every reachable returned parameter must either have a physical input binding or its branch must be proven unreachable and removed. Interpreter, JIT, and AOT must agree.

## Exact reproducer

```fz
fn pick(b, f, g) do
  if b do f else g end
end

fn main() do
  a = fn(x) -> x > 0 end
  b = fn(x) -> x < 0 end
  h = pick(true, a, b)
  dbg(Enum.drop_while([], h))
  dbg(Enum.drop_while([1, 2, 3], h))
end
```

Elixir oracle:

```text
[]
[]
```

Measured at a3a9761d1:

- interp: rc 1, `backend value 1 is unbound`
- JIT: rc 1, `error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]`, native executable lowering failed for index 5
- AOT: build rc 1, same index-5 native lowering failure

## Important reductions

The two calls are not independently red.

With only `dbg(Enum.drop_while([], h))`, all three doors succeed and print `[]`. That path proves the predicate unused, so omitting the callable is valid and must remain valid.

With only `dbg(Enum.drop_while([1, 2, 3], h))`, interp reports `backend value 1 is unbound`, while JIT and AOT fail native lowering.

Enum is not required. Replacing the calls with `dbg(h.(1))` has the same all-door failure. Choosing `true` makes interpreter report value 1 unbound; choosing `false` makes it report value 2 unbound.

## Current plan evidence

The backend executable for `pick/3` has:

```text
param_reprs [RawAtom]
semantic_inputs
  0 lane(... RawAtom)
```

Its callable parameters are absent:

```text
v1 : closure[...] / -
v2 : closure[...] / -
```

but its reachable branch bodies still contain:

```text
tail value v1 -> return
tail value v2 -> return
```

The runtime-demand dump does not say these inputs are wholly unused: inputs 1 and 2 carry non-empty callable demand. Main also constructs both closure objects and calls `pick/3` with them. The physical transport/ABI projection drops them before the branch reads them.

The interpreter faithfully leaves omitted semantic inputs unbound in `bind_executable_inputs`, then `env_get_value` reports the missing value. Native lowering does the same omission and later trips its bound-before-runtime-use invariant. These consumers are exposing the broken plan; they are not separate bugs to patch.

## Scope / history correction

fz-kdt.127's construction identity work is present: the two source closures have distinct construction wrappers, and `callable_union_capture_containment.fz` is green on interp, JIT, and AOT. The present failure happens when `pick/3` transports its callable parameters, not when Enum's wrapper closure captures the returned union.

fz-kdt.107 and fz-kdt.108 are closed dispatch/order work and are not the first triage point here. The reduced direct invocation contains no Enum wrapper, and `pick/3` uses an ordinary `if`, not a runtime dispatch matrix.

## Strategy

1. Add a red three-door behavioral fixture for the direct reduced witness, exercising both selected arguments.
2. Add the exact Enum.drop_while reproducer as the end-to-end regression.
3. Pin the artifact invariant: no reachable `BackendTail::Value` may read a function parameter whose executable-entry contract provides no binding. Pruning a statically unreachable branch is also valid.
4. Trace the first loss from the non-empty callable `RuntimeDemand` through callable-owner/transport-position publication into `BackendSemanticInputLayout`.
5. Repair the shared transport/ABI plan. Do not special-case interpreter, native lowering, `if`, or Enum.
6. Preserve the empty-list-only control: a callback proven unused must stay absent rather than being materialized defensively.

## Acceptance

- Direct selection and invocation works for both arms on interp, JIT, and AOT.
- The exact two-line Enum reproducer prints `[]` then `[]` on all three doors.
- The isolated empty-list call remains green without forcing a dead callback into the runtime ABI.
- No reachable backend tail reads an unbound semantic input.
- Existing joined-callable, connected-callable-return, fz-kdt.111 dead-closure, and callable-union containment gates remain green.
- Run focused tests, all three fixture lanes, `cargo fmt --check`, strict clippy, `cargo test --lib`, and the fixture matrix.
title: Callable arguments selected by an if-returning forwarder are omitted from its ABI; consuming the selected closure fails on all three doors
